After her [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]] in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] was given a '''traditional [[Jedi funeral/Legends|Jedi funeral]]''' in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

Following her funeral, [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] was appointed to succeed Yaddle on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. The members of the Council were present for the funeral.
